rule.name: JvmHeapWithoutGoal
rule.message: This java command sets a heap ceiling (-Xmx or -XX:MaxRAMPercentage) and no heap goal, and it is started once per element, task or call of a loop. Each JVM grows to its ceiling and keeps that memory, so the JVMs together hold far more than their live data. Add -XX:GCTimeRatio=4 (or -XX:SoftMaxHeapSize, -XX:MaxHeapFreeRatio) next to the ceiling.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $steps := ('forEach', 'map', 'mapToInt', 'mapToLong', 'mapToDouble', 'mapToObj', 'flatMap', 'filter', 'peek', 'anyMatch', 'allMatch', 'noneMatch', 'submit', 'execute', 'supplyAsync', 'runAsync', 'schedule', 'invokeAll', 'invokeAny'), $repeated := function($node) { exists($node/ancestor::*[self::ForeachStatement or self::ForStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement or self::LambdaExpression[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = $steps]]]) }, $texts := function($arguments) { let $method := $arguments/ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1], $names := $arguments/*/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess/@Name return ($arguments//StringLiteral | $method//LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $names]//StringLiteral | $method//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('add', 'addAll')][*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $names]]] /ArgumentList//StringLiteral)/string(@ConstValue) }, $ceiling := function($text) { starts-with($text, '-Xmx') or starts-with($text, '-XX:MaxRAMPercentage') or contains($text, ' -Xmx') or contains($text, ' -XX:MaxRAMPercentage') }, $goal := function($text) { contains($text, '-XX:GCTimeRatio') or contains($text, '-XX:SoftMaxHeapSize') or contains($text, '-XX:MaxHeapFreeRatio') }, $java := function($text) { some $word in tokenize($text, '\s+') satisfies $word = 'java' or ends-with($word, '/bin/java') }, $method := function($node) { $node/ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration][1] }, $started := function($node) { $repeated($node) or (let $name := $method($node)/@Name, $class := $node/ancestor::ClassBody[last()] return exists($class//MethodCall[@MethodName = $name] [empty(*[1][not(self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression)])][$repeated(.)] | $class//MethodReference[@MethodName = $name][*[1][self::ThisExpression]][$repeated(.) or parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = $steps]])) }, $launches := //ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.ProcessBuilder')][ArgumentList/@Size > 0] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.ProcessBuilder#command(_*)')] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Runtime#exec(_*)')] return ($launches[let $texts := $texts(ArgumentList) return exists($texts[$java(.)]) and exists($texts[$ceiling(.)]) and empty($texts[$goal(.)])] [$started(.)] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'put'][ArgumentList/@Size = 2] [*[1][self::MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.ProcessBuilder#environment()')]]] [ArgumentList/*[1][@ConstValue = ('JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS', 'JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS')]] [let $texts := $texts(ArgumentList) return exists($texts[$ceiling(.)]) and empty($texts[$goal(.)])] [$started(.)])
